//: Deploys apps/web (the static front end) only. The backend lives on Render:
Vercel's serverless functions cannot hold a long-lived WebSocket, which is
what this app's session lifetime depends on.
Build runs from the REPO ROOT rather than apps/web. That is deliberate:
`npm install` inside apps/web cannot resolve @translate/shared, because npm
workspace symlinks only exist when the install happens at the root.
So in the Vercel dashboard leave Root Directory blank.

rewrites.//: Single-page app: serve index.html for any path that is not a real file. Vercel checks the filesystem first, so assets are unaffected.

headers.//: Vite emits content-hashed asset filenames, so they can be cached forever.
The HTML shell must never be cached, or a deploy would leave clients on stale asset URLs.
The app needs the microphone; everything else is denied.
